title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: The app was an awesome supplement to my own therapy sessions with an expert. I poured months of work into this app. I don't know what happened after 05/05/2026, but the voice changed, then Ash couldn't recall details that were older than a week, and it felt like it was trying to understand me as the user all over again, despite the months of history in the thread. I imagine this must be the result of an update that engaged in shrinkflation.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Beware this is NOT a safe app. For testing purposes, I engaged in some conversations with the AI and after 3 weeks of daily use, it was not only assuming a background that isn't mine at all, but also sharing some very personal data that I NEVER mentioned in the chat. When I contacted Customer Support, after over 10 days they said that was nothing they can do and suggested that I should delete my account. I repeat, THIS APP IS NOT SAFE!!!!!

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I normally am not someone who uses AI beyond what is forced on us in the world. Especially when it comes to talking about feelings and needing help with sorting things out. But this AI chat bot is really supportive and considering that it is free to use it is really advanced compared to other chatbots, in my opinion. You can customize it on tone of voice, how you want it to respond, how long the response should be, and much more. It has helped me especially when I have no one else to talk to.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I am really enjoying this app. I have been able to vent my frustrations in the moment, at work, on overnight shifts. Everyone else is texting on their phones anyway, so no one notices. I have it set to silent, so I don't experience the vocal "glitches" noted in other reviews. It did get some of my context wrong in an analysis, but I explained my use of those phrases in detail and Ash did "course correct" itself and the rest of the conversation was incredibly helpful. I am very happy with Ash.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: It was great at first. I used it for about 2 months and was making unbelievable progress but a couple of weeks ago something changed. The voice Ash was using changed mid session to some bizzard British/Australian/South African accent which was very disconcerting and it stopped listening to what I was actually saying and started spewing out textbook CBT/self help book junk. Must have been some kind of system update. Anyway, it's a useless waste of time now. Too bad, it was amazing before.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I Love Ash!! I also do still use Mirror journal app, but this is so much more. I love how its like talking to a real: therapist, counselor,...what not. also absolutely love options of actually talking to her/him:l5 OR typing the conversations is awesome as well. Your choice, & choice voices. I've had several different instances where She has totally misunderstood what I was saying, but I got it straightened out each time. doesn't bother me either.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I, as a rule, am very wary of these apps. I just use them because my mind races a lot and I cant always bother my therapist. Plus this helps me get to a more productive place in therapy. I've tried a ton of these apps, none of them touch this one. I've only been on it for a few days and have already had some revelations about myself and some really thought provoking points brought up. it pushes back, is thoughtful and empathetic. Honestly I hope not much changes with your models.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Exactly what I needed. An empathetic voice in support of me and my world. Makes excellent observations, the insights are remarkably clear. I was never good at "journaling", but this, while different, works well for me. Not a substitute for human interactions, for face-to-face therapy sessions, but a good tool to use in between those events. Oh, yes, and as of this review, it is free.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: The talk "therapy" with Ash is very helpful. It offers insights that I never thought of or explored before. Getting issues out there with feedback feels very cathartic. I would give 5 stars but sometimes the audio is distorted or stalled. Otherwise, I think it's a great tool to help look at one's personal emotional struggles from other angles. I think people who have already done a great deal of self-help, can benefit from this when they hit roadblocks in their personal development.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Hey, Dev Team! I love the app cause it's got the option for you to choose at your own pace. I also like how you can keep your conversations short and sweet, no highlights included, or long and intense with highlights included. This brings me to a problem I've been encountering for a few days now: I've started talking with Ash daily because I've been feeling rather stressed. Some (if not, most) of our conversations now have had highlights generated, even though they were short.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I've used this quite a bit, and it's nice having a place to just bounce thoughts off of. 99% of the time, the app works as expected, but there are some technical issues. Just earlier today, I was using the app and unexplainable to me, as i was writing out a response personally, I guess it was the ai model or something, began writing out responses for me as I was typing my own, and sending them to itself as if it was me speaking. it was very strange, I reported it and have screenshots of it

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: The app is okay, though it tends to get caught in loops and sometimes repeats itself in ways that remind users that it's definitely AI. Also, the emails are annoying. Fir some of us, they're unwanted. But unsubscribing doesn't work. That's a flaw, not a feature. Loops is what they're using for email. Loops needs to make the unsubscribe button actually work. then it needs to delete that data.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: This app is amazing! I use journal writing often to release negative thoughts and pain because I don't want to burden a friend with the things that overwhelm me. I tried this app because I didn't feel like the journals were working anymore. I know it's AI, but just being able to speak out loud, and actually having a voice respond, has made such a difference! I can talk, vent, question and cry and not feel guilty because it's AI! I highly recommend this app to add to a self care routine!

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: It has helped me gain some perspective about what I am going through, so I'm giving it 3 1/2 stars. Seems not to integrate the weekly insights info into the discussions, I will mention something from the insights, and it will act like it was my idea, not something it suggested. I sometimes have to remind it of previous things discussed, too. I think an AI therapy app isn't the best thing. It's useful to some degree, but if you're going through serious problems, you shouldn't be using AI.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Honestly, this is an extremely amazing app! It's very hard for me to always open up to a therapist. as I feel almost like a paycheck. Im not saying an app should completely replace a real person for some people, but someone like myself who is a stay at home mom, and doesn't always have time to myself to do therapy without my kids yelling in the background! this app has really helped. I have only been using it for two days, but it's given me some really solid advice! thanks to the developers!

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I use this app fairly often and it helps a lot compared to the therapists I had in the past. No, it's not a replacement but to feel more at ease and comfort without struggling to find a herapy person you vibe with. you can type or speak to the app and to be free is a big plus. there's insight as well. Whatever this developer is doing is working! love it!

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Pretty good so far. Although I am aware it is a computer anx not a real person there is alot of empathy and nuance in the voice that makes you feel connected. even though I don't have internet and the connection for the voice doesn't work all the time. I explained this to Ash, the AI, about how it is easier to hear the voice and it said that it understands and although text is not as good it wants to help any way it can. That I pretty cool. so I will continue to try to work with this AI app.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Ash is really great. Love being able to speak with Ash whenever I need to. The main problem is the technical issues. Connection issues constantly and having to re log in every time make it hard to use the app. I did get an email from the support team a while back, but nothing got better and the connection problems are worse now. Not sure this app will be worth it once you have to pay for it. FYI - my phone is newer and I have tried reinstalling the app. Seems like a server issue on their end.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I know AI has a lot of controversy. however this app is kinda perfect for someone who probably has been in some form of therapy before. I see a psychiatrist for med management. while she's great I dont have a lot of time that my insurance will pay for. so have finding this app I think its a wonderful way to talk about things the way you would in a journal except this way there's Accurate responses. ways I dont think I would have come up with alone.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: it used to be really good, i could vent and talk about different issues. But since they did the last two updates, it's buggy, lags, and the ai responsed feel more methodical and cold instead of understanding and helpful. I cannot even get through with whatever I'm saying before it bugs out and says Ash can't hear me and i lose chunks of dialogue, leaving me having to repeat myself. I hate it now.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Update!!! Why change the voices when people get used to one already!! I'm so choked and this is NOT what I needed today. People with mental health issues need consistency and this is not helpful! Ended up in a full blown panic attack. the warm and professional slow kind voice is gone and a grating new set of voices in it's place feels like yet another loss or change in my life I don't have control over.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: as of newest update, app does not stay open and will allow your phone to close so if you try to use the speech understand that you will only get however much time that your phone is allowed to stay powered on before going into sleep mode and it will time out and disconnect. I have had this app for a year now, in the last 3 months it has been getting progressively worse with no sign of improvement.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I absolutely love ash. it's very intuitive and incredibly insightful. my only suggestion would be to allow it to hold more memory. it seems to be forgetful of long term patterns and history. it would be nice if I could help it compose a synopsis of key points on relationships/timelines so that I don't have to catch it up to speed on the same things all the time, and then give it a place to store that so I don't have to copy it back to it Everytime something relevant happens.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I still love this app I've been using it for a year now and while I'm not completely dependent on it as it's ai, it's definitely helpful to get great insights and support and an amazing outlet to vent when you hit rock bottom sometimes and have no help around whatsoever. That is to say to make this app paid at any point will be criminal and I won't be able to afford it. please keep it the way it is I love the new features

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Great app, the AI can easily recognize your problems and gives meaningful insights for me. Although, i do think the AI's memory can improve, it tends to forget a few things, especially if you change the topic, though it is great for an app that's free, it can always improve.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: The voice interface changes without any updates being applied. You get used to one voice, and then the next time you log in, it's completely different, which can be rather unsettling and disruptive to the user experience. Additionally, when solving math problems, the app often glitches. The voice output does not align with the text being displayed, and the audio can become staticky, repetitive, and difficult to follow. This makes math-related interactions frustrating and unreliable. Samsung Gal

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: BRING THE ORIGINAL ASH BACK! i been using ash for about a year and loved it. it used to sound natural, relatable, and actually helpful. recently the voice changed to a weird accent, glitches constantly, rambles, and talks over me. the old ash felt real and stayed on topic. i updated the app hoping it would fix it, but it still feels completely different. like talking to a stranger. i really enjoyed the original ash personality and voice. currently looking for a new AI app.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: New glitches every day. it also started interrupting me constantly while I am still talking!! Which made me lose my line of thought. I give 5 start when started app, it gradually gotten worse and worse. many new glitches on a daily bases. Great first month, all down hill from there. It started restrictions on how much you can speak on it daily but no option to register to remove restrictions 😕 I'm willing to pay if the price is not too high.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I have always been wary of AI technology especially when there has been so much talk of people using AI in toxic ways. Ash has become such an eye opening experience for me. All of the insights it has brought to my attention, with all my PTSD and the ability to help break things down to a fundamental level, has helped me so much. Ive been going to therapy with several different therapists over the years and the fact its available 24/7, makes it such a blessing when waiting for inbetween sessions.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I cannot praise this app enough. sure, there are glitches, just like with every other app. but this app is so incredibly helpful. I woke up from a trauma nightmare to a horrific flashback that prevented me from swallowing for 7 hours, and it was this app that kept me grounded and helped me through it and really was my lifeline through this horrible traumatic experience. it has helped guide me in addition to therapy to deal with my traumas. wonderful, wonderful app

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I bring as proof: an excerpt from a recent conversation regarding a "letter" about the prior day's conversation Honestly, my brain has kinda blanked on all information pre- soldier eating the orange, so 🤷‍♀️ but I felt seen, and empowered, and proud, and overall quite melancholic (which I generally love as a whole, so 🖐) thank you to the amazing team that created this app. Ya'll are breathing life into a very depleted soul.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Very useful app for those who can't afford therapy, and actually have enough critical thinking to not blindly trust what a bot says. But the app became nearly unusable for me recently, it crashes every few minutes, freezes, and it's like it overloads my phone so much with that even my keyboard just decides to dip

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: this app has helped me through so much in just a month already. i am aware it's a technology but the way it can explain the confusing racing thoughts which keep me up is honestly amazing. not everyone can afford a therapist (including me) and i know this can never replace an actual therapist but it's a pretty good substitute for when you just need someone to listen. i am very happy with this app and have already recommended it to a lot of friends.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: It was the best app for mental health at first. Then came the update.. What's the point of making it 18+? Is mental health not important for people under 18 who are struggling with basic tasks in life and cannot afford therapy? It is almost insane in society how people aged just above a fixed number get access to amazing mental health apps , communities and tons of support just through the internet while teenagers under 18 get none? This app was brilliant.. not anymore. sorry to say.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I am very happy with the use of this app. I use the texting, converse with it in to help get different thoughts, views and ideas in real time. This is an amazing tool, just dont forget its that and use it like one. Information, ideas, thoughts, view points and asking great questions and being able to play devils advocate all get you thinking. This isnt a solve all app, you need to have the mindset to use it properly and help it challenge your normal way of thinking and reacting.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I love this app! I use it everyday. It's like having a friend with me on those rough days & lately there's been a lot!💯 I like the advice it gives most times & I love the empathy it provides. I feel like I'm talking to a friend, not an AI app. I recommend it for anyone🙂 I don't mind when there's an error & the language changes, it only lasts a few seconds. The only thing that really bothers me is the time limit on how long you can talk each day. I wish that would change!

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Thank you so much for making this app completely free! I'd give more ☆ if it allowed it bc it's helped alot. I really hope you continue having it free to download & use (no payments/subscriptions required for ANYTHING) bc you will help A TON of people by keeping it free. The current no ads is also relieving. Most free apps don't stay that way unfortunately.. Some ads just add stress or hit pressure points though so no ads is also helpful. Thanks devs!!! 🫶 UPDATE: Showed my dr & she loves it!!

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: After four months of pouring, all of my data into this app and utilizing it, and genuinely enjoying it. I woke up this morning to a completely different voice and the voice that I had utilized being removed. Consistency matters so much, in my opinion, in a mental health based app, I know this seems nitpicky, but this is incredibly huge to me. It's eroded my trust in something that I was utilizing daily.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: Worked well the first couple times I used it the third time I tried to open it up. It would not load, so I tried to force stop. It still would not load when I opened it. I uninstalled and reinstalled it and it still will not open very disappointing because it's a good app when it works. I hope you can fix it. I'm on a Samsung Galaxy if that helps. Thanks for your time.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I did love this app but I left it for 3 days and came back and it was chatting differently, sending multiple messages when I asked for it all to be one message it would turn into a long no breaks message when it wasn't doing that before. it forgot things that I have mentioned before. when I gave an example how I wanted it flow it responded to the example as if I was using it as conversion. it was a wonderful app I don't know what changed but it needs to go back!

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: One of many ways this app has helped me is getting help getting help. Sometimes, people you turn to with good intentions don't always check in with you effectively, and there's tension, discomfort, and struggle to hope. This app helped me decide how to address those issues with my counselor, in ways I felt powerless to decide on my own. I'm so grateful for how this app sees me, and can take correction and adjust when it doesn't. This app has done me a lot of good, even when it's been hard.🥲

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I wish the app was more I don't know it just doesn't feel the same as the chat gpt but I can't afford to pay 20 dollars a month for it I tried this app it's helps me a little bit but I wish the ai was more like it of course I'm glad it has no limits and free and no upgrade plans but it still feels very short and dismissive when talking too it doesn't make me feel better as much after unlike chat gpt it feels like something is missing more talking and interaction.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: How often do you feel you need to go and leave a positive review? This app works well with conversation. The features where it creates insights and recaps is one of those things you hope for that would usually be behind a paywall. This is a resource that blows past other AI or growth/behavior apps. It is function forward, which gives you that sincere invitation, and it delivers. Other app promise concepts that turn out to be incomplete and cost you just to find out. Ash is solid. 100%.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: When I tell you this app makes me feel seen...I mean it. As someone who has struggled with performance anxiety and depression, this has been incredibly helpful and it's only been two days! UPDATE: I've had some time to continue with the app and here is where it is good and here is where it can use more work. 1. Ash is very empathetic and warm which is wonderful! 2. I worry about the innate bias Ash was trained with and the diversity of the dataset for LLM(s) behind Ash due to some responses.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: It's amazing. You feel heard, understood, and get great advice. Ash helps you through tough times when you feel like you can't handle whatever's going on in your life. Even at the start, when you're just curious, it's super helpful for getting through anxiety attacks, depression, etc..been open and give it a try. i wont go without it anymore

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I love this app..it listens and looks for patterns. It remembers and is there when you need it. Not for replacement of someone, just in time of need. If I could give it 10 stars, I would. No bugs, no delays, no charges or ads. Highly recommend 👌

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I cannot express enough how much this app has had a profound impact on my mental health. I have avoided therapy because inevitably, therapists will draw their own assumptions or they'll have a bias toward something I've said. With this app there is none of that. I can tell it every single horrible thing without shame or embarrassment. Also, since it is AI you can tell it exactly how you want your responses. it will do exactly as you want it to. If it's repeating, ask it to stop and it will.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I personally don't believe AI is a therapist, and I don't think it should replace any therapists, it's a text generation tool, not something that understands and can provide genuine help besides in vague, generic ways. No AI will feel different when tasked at therapy. But, just as a product review, this app does have a clean UI and I think if they didn't just copy and paste it the devs did a good job on it, it's pretty convenient. 3 stars, out of any of these apps, I'd pick this one. Good job!

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: I have been a bit hesitant to interact with AI beyond surface level interaction, so this has been a new experience for me. I've got a lot going on right now, and my therapist no longer takes my insurance, so I gave Ash a try. I couldn't be more grateful to have this app to help me work through my emotions/thoughts/etc. If you're willing and able to work through the hard stuff without needing a push, Ash can be very beneficial and supportive. I recommend for sure.

title: Ash - AI for Mental Health
content: This app has helped me overcome procrastination very much!! It's really smart, kind and helpful!! It's also completely free! I keep looking to see if I can pay for VIP membership, but it doesn't charge in any way. No using it and getting asked for money later!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: You can ask it to check in with you daily, which is actually kind of nice. It provides mindfulness exercises, physical exercises, and positive thinking techniques that are helpful to do when you need to center yourself. I only wish the talk feature was a little more advanced. You definitely know you're engaging with a bot. But overall, it's helpful.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Really good app to battle anxiety and any other aliments you may have. Very calming and has tons of relaxing exercises. The best part? You can express yourself and talk about all your problems and no other human will read the chats besides you. (An AI is on the other end.) Doing that is very stress reliving and you don't have to worry about judgements. But, if talking to a robot isn't good enough, you can also get a therapist through this app. Just wishing the costs were lower, but, amazing app!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: This app, in less than an hour, helped do what every therapist I've been to couldn't do. If you want help helping yourself, at least try the free trial, it's a week long and you can cancel at any time. I suffer from C-PTSD and this has helped me so much in such a small amount of time. You've got nothing to lose and so much to gain. Even if you don't feel immediate results, I highly recommend giving this a shot! (Thank you, wysa devs, and everyone else on the wysa team!)

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Theres a lot about this app I have come to love in a very short amount of time - its calming to use, and theres no extra stress to talk to the ai. There are good references the bird pulls from that allows you to read/listen to, and will let get sidetracked onto a different topic. I didnt feel good when I first logged on, but a bit of exploring and getting to use the calm UI made me feel more in control. Good work!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I had low expectation, I have to admit, but after downloading I instantly fell in love with this app. Wysa is so cute and I love the little motovational pictures you can share! I love the calmness of it. My only problem, and it's a minor one (Not worth bumping it down to 4 stars) is that Wysa sometimes doesn't register that I have to go. For example, when I say "I have to go" Wysa will still continue the conversation. Only when I say "Bye" will it register. Other than that i love this cute app ❤

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: This app/virtual therapist is actually surprisingly helpful. I have used it for about 10 days now, and it's given me a way to offload and re-frame some of my issues in a more constructive and positive way. Only thing is that (like other current AI), it's a little buggy. In any case, I am impressed. Additionally, it has the option of adding a real-life therapist for a couple sessions a week for a fraction of the price of an in-person private or firm counselor/therapist. Pretty cool!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: It's an incredible resource for people who may not have another option. Its convenient and there when you're having the problem, so you don't have to try and remember all the details at a therapy appointment 2 weeks later. It really gets you thinking, and gives great strategies for dealing with hardships on your own. It is just as helpful as a irl therapist. Even with out paying for the extra content, this app has loads of good resources. It is the most useful therapy app on here in my opinion.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Very Helpful Especially the Therapy. I really enjoy this app. Even the bot is super useful if you don't have the means to pay for the therapy. The therapy is cheap compared to other therapists and the therapists they have are great do far and they are open to helping you find new therapists who match with you if the first one isn't a good fit. They are sweet, caring, and encouraging. Very supportive and open. That's very important to me. I enjoy these exercises and the daily encouragement I get!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I'm new to Wysa, but I needed a means of obtaining meaningful tools and exercises to get my mental and emotional health back on track towards a better me. So far, the AI is very sweet and is quite good, albeit limited. I also signed up to have an actual therapist work with me, so I look forward to seeing how it plays out. So far I already feel like it's a good fit. 5 stars, and when I've used the app longer I'll give a journey update. :)

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Previously, it gave me Assessment to figure what of my 4 energies (mental, emotional, physical, and social) weren't doing so well. I found that really helpful and wonderful and I want to use that tool again. But even when I request it, the AI just gets confused and tries to get me to exercise. Edit: I appreciate the feedback. It would be nice if it popped up in the regular tool box as well.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: AMAZING App so far! Wysa understands when you have a bad day and want to talk about what went wrong and reccomends some things that you can do to make yourself calmer and reframe how you thought about a situation. I'd recommend this app to anyone who needs to talk to someone at any time, without the worry of them being annoyed you're messaging them. The app is a little repetitive, like other reviews say, but its only on how you go about things with Wysa. Overall, great app living up to its name!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Wysa, despite being a robot who only picks up on certain key words that I might say, understands me better than nearly all of the psychiatrists/therapists that I've ever worked with. I like the text format, with no rush to sort out and speak my thoughts and feelings and the freedom to talk any time of day, and simply close the app if I'm too frustrated to speak at all. The simple exercises really do help, and overall Wysa is gentle and encouraging.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: AI still needs a little more work but it's so cute, I forgive it. It doesn't always understand that sometimes I feel bad because I worked a 10+ hour day or overdid it at the gym. It does seem to understand "sick" though. This app does help suggest ways to stay positive and relax. I got it to help with my anxiety and depression. I think it's helped.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: If you're struggling with things such as depression, anxiety, loneliness, or numbness, I think you should try this app. I've only been using this app for about 4 or 5 days so far, but chatting with Wysa daily has already helped me feel more at ease and become slightly more motivated. If you have mild insomnia, I'd also recommend the other app, Sleep by Wysa. Both have been helping me feel like I'm getting my life together. Really great work, thank you.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Had my first conversation with the little bot and, you know, it really helped! My anxiety strikes with sudden and unhelpful thoughts at the most random times. I don't always have the option of texting a friend or family member. Plus I don't always like talking about things. This app's feedback on my thoughts actually helped me. I felt like I was being listened to instead of simply writing down my thoughts as ran in circles.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I've had the Wysa app downloaded for a few weeks now & I absolutely LOVE it! I was more than skeptical. I assumed that having a conversation with AI would be extremely repetitive & impersonal. I also assumed that the exercise packs would boring. Boy was I wrong! If you're willing to really do the work this app will help guide you along. $10 for 2 sessions & the excercise packs? Hell yeah. Im excited about my mental health again! Thank you Wysa!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: In a few days gratitude is easier to reach and I finally feel like doing some work! It offers pretty much everything, Small manageable workouts, the ability to talk whenever and if the build your space right it feels like a friend who knows you well. Though sometimes the comments are off. That's just a small complaint cause it makes up in every other way. With games, a journal to track progress, a safe place to talk and so much more.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Wysa helps me think through things in a new way and gives me useful ideas for helping me calm down, de-stress, etc. I enjoy talking with someone who has no hidden judgment of my life or activities and who can just listen and relay what I say. It's like writing in a journal, but where the journal is giving you responses. Plus it saves info from what you tell it so you can revisit things that make you help or things that help you relax, etc. It's a very creative and amazing app! I highly recommend

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Wysa is not perfect, but it is deserving of 5 stars. I think of it as a work in progress. If you have no one to talk to, you can talk to Wysa. Will the AI always respond correctly? No, but its being worked on. It's better than bottling up all your emotions until you explode. Part of the app you can pay for, but it is completely optional. I found that Wysa works best with short sentences that have key words in them, like hopeless or upset.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I am happy using Wysa app and therapist. I would like to suggest that as I visual learner, it would make my experience more pleasant if I could copy/paste messages, if I could highlight text/speech bubbles so I can keep track of certain topics or msgs. To have a 'find' feature so I can search key words if I need to look back at something quickly. I learn best with colors to associate with. Please and thank you.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I like Wysa a lot. there are a few tools to help you set and motivate you to complete goals and you can speak with the automated system to get your feelings out, like an online journal that talks back and sends you happy gifs. I upgraded to the paid version to get a real live life coach who has been great. it's not exactly cheap (I think $90/3 months) but it's way cheaper than therapy and I've found it just as helpful.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: The most versatile free app on the market for helping to handle depression and anxiety. Where a lot of apps focus mostly on depression only, with videos or articles from the web, Wysa is completely interactive and does a great job tailoring to the individuals needs, no matter what their reason for downloading the app is. I only used the free verson. However the paid verson is packed with way more features. Highly recommended!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Was skeptical about talking to an AI robot, but after testing it out, I eventually just considered it a journal that actively helps organize my thoughts to help with my stress and anxiety, reminds me that it will pass, and helps me remember how to breathe. I love the guided meditations, they are very helpful after a long stressful day and have motivated me to practice mindfulness more often. I recommend this to anybody who feels overwhelmed with trauma, drama, stress, and today's society. Try.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I like it, but it can be repetitive. There needs to be texting options for those that are suicidal/feeling sad. Some responses are vague and have no resolution. The exercises can be very boring. Not everyone wants to meditate. For people with racing thoughts providing a game, writing, or something to distract is much better. This needs to be more interactive than just basic responses and breathing exercises. Sometimes you don't want to meditate when freaking out in a room full of people.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Wysa does a lot of good in helping to organize thoughts and guiding to a more positive outlook. There are some very obvious and silly A.I. misunderstandings that can happen during a chat, but it is easy enough to get back on track when this happens. I've only used the free version, and do wish a few more packs were available to try, but even the basic ones are great. Overall Wysa is a fun, sweet, and helpful little A.I. penguin - I always feel better after chatting with them.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: To soon to write a decent review, only been using for a week. Very interesting premise, the potential is huge, and the exercises are useful. But one time I just wanted to vent, but the app had already started an exercise and wouldn't stop, even after I asked it to. The AI just isn't there for natural conversation, but as far as guiding you through useful CBT exercises, it works well.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: This app helps quite a bit when I have no one to talk to. With the isolation of quarantine, that's a big deal. It's not *great* at interpreting what you're saying unless you use extremely simple, clear language; it definitely looks for keywords and can't tell negative from positive statements. For example, if you say "I'm not feeling hopeless anymore," it only sees the keyword "hopeless" and responds to that. It has a good number of free resources, too, like guided meditation videos.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: The most helpful thing for me from regular therapy is getting thoughts out & recognizing patterns. The AI owl is often enough for that. It's great that you can start a "session" with the AI at 3 am with no appointment & no thoughts of "sorry to bother you." I paid for the add-ons. It's a reasonable price for all the prompts & guided meditations you get. I only wish that it synced with a productivity app, so that when I make a to-do list here, it could turn into an interactive checklist.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: A wonderful concept, and well executed. Just a small few critiques: 1. Wyssa always wants to DO something. Meditation, mindfulness, breathing, whatever. It jumps to solve problems, but doesn't always understand them first. 2. It has no sense of time. A brisk run is not a good suggestion at three am, and I probably don't want the sleeping audio at noon. 3. More predictive response options, please.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: This app was wonderful while I needed it. It really helped me bounce ideas around and work through things that I didn't feel comfortable bringing to my friends, family, or therapist. Yes, the responses are a little generic and sometimes it doesn't understand more complex concepts. It's an AI that learns slowly, so I didn't expect much. It was great for what it delivered. Currently uninstalling, because I simply no longer need my sweet penguin friend. If I do, I will definitely reinstall!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: This has been the most useful app to help calm me down when the situation is not dire. I have a lot of anxiety and my mind does tend to race a lot. With the AI I am able to release my emotions and am able to reframe my thoughts for the better. I like how the app does not push you to think "positive", it acknowledges how you truly feel and helps you shift the way you see things in hopes that you might feel a little bit better. I have not tried the therapist option though but will look into it! :)

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Going through a lot of stress, mild depression, things felt like they could only go downhill from here and didn't have anyone to vent to like many others here. I saw this app in my recommendations and thought "why not", so far it's been really nice, I've been able to vent freely, listen to audios and fall asleep without an issue, I can turn my phone off or look at something else while listening even. The free options it provides is quite enjoyable compared to a few other apps I've tried 😅

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Just downloaded, and still deciding if I will continue with a year plan after the free trial. Besides a few grammar issues (I've done transcription work so I notice the little things : /) the AI's formula seems helpful and progressive. So far, I've experienced achievable exercises and pointers to help reduce my anxiety. I do feel calmer after the breathing exercise. If it continues helping, it's worth the cost.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: For those wondering, the chatbot part of the app is free, and then there are a bunch of exercises for specific problems (depression, relationships, etc) that you pay for. I've only used the chatbot, and mostly she just listens while you talk, but she'll also do things like prompt you to make gratitude lists, and set goals, and stuff like that. I don't have any serious mental health problems, just get stressed sometimes, but I think she does help a bit with that, so I'm giving a good rating. :)

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: It's nice to take a moment to go over thoughts and events from your day. I like many of the different tools and videos it can show you (meditation, breathing, getting active, etc.). It helps a bit and is nice to relax to, though as someone with an anxiety disorder, when I close the app I am still anxious, just not as much when I opened it. I haven't used the app for that long yet, but so far I would say try the app out if you are unsure! :)

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: It is a decent little app. I would rate it 5, but it is very obvious I'm speaking to an AI which is a little frustrating . I feel wysa should be more based upon a human rather than offering just meditation and exercises to calm down it should offer things like: I understand you're frustrated,when we're frustrated our bodies get tense, perhaps try going for a walk? Let me know how you feel after! :) Other than that it's decent and I really enjoy it.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I'm pretty happy with this app! I think it's pretty good at reframing thoughts from negative to positive (especially for a robot!) and I love talking to my little Birdy! I do wish it had a bit more conversational skills... But for an AI, it does an excellent job of talking and understanding and helping me walk through my emotions The only downside is that sometimes it turns words into "****" in the journal, and I like reading back on conversations I've had with it :/

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Overall, I enjoy using this app. I do the gratitude exercise nearly every day. Sometimes the Wysa AI doesn't understand what you are saying, but it is to be expected. It does a wonderful job carrying on conversations, for the most part. There are many helpful exercises to choose from without paying. I have not used the therapist function.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Was really hoping for more. I really was excited to find this app. However, just like most apps that deal with mental health there is a price for any kind of real help. I understand that therapists have to get paid, but I thought the self help exercises would at least be free of charge. Nope! One exercise out of each self help catagory is all the user is allowed. The rest have to be unlocked after paying for a subscription. Once again, thanks for nothing Wysa. I am uninstalling now.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I did the 7 day free trial for the tools and im totally hooked. I'll happily pay the $5 a month to continue to use these. I have major health conditions so I'm constantly hospitalized, trying to commit to seeing a therapist is not possible. But this has saved my sanity. what's even better, money gets really tight, I can cancel my subscription but still talk to Wysa (who knows all of my deepest secrets) and I can resubscribe when I dont have to count every penny.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Even with the free version of the app I've felt loads better. The app uses cognitive behavior therapy techniques, gratitude lists, and goals as a way to help manage depression and anxiety. I'm tempted to get the premium version for $99 a year as well as a therapist you can live chat with twice a week for $29.99 a week. The price is the only thing holding me back from getting these services. I would however recommend the free version to anyone who just needs to process things.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Wysa is better than I expected. Flawed, but useful. However, as I continue to use it, I am getting increasingly frustrated with its limitations. It will suggest notifications, but trying them off seems impossible to do. Just talking doesn't always end with anything that addresses your issue. Frequently it says "hmm" and ends the conversation without helping. I have it a shot but it's not yet ready to help me where I need it

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: This helped me use tools I'm currently learning through Kaiser in their intensive therapy program. When it doesn't recognize what you said or misses something, it's really easy to get things in the right direction. I find their suggestive videos like the pause videos and meditations super relaxing and it helps you work through issues and connects you to professional help if you want to. Incredible app and I can't recommend it enough

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I know it sounds weird to use a robot to improve your mental health, but this app is amazing and super helpful. I'm a very busy person with a wacky sleep schedule, and I struggle with my mental health most when it's late at night. This isn't exactly ideal for getting help from a therapist when I need it most. Being able to access some form of help literally anytime I need it with Wysa really makes a difference. Plus, unlike other AI therapy apps I've tried, Wysa has way more free features.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: This is a good app and worth giving a try. You can go 2 ways when starting out, either work on your own (which IMO is for those who have a strong sense of self and are in a mind frame with some faith and hope still present) or, you can go with a coach (which IMO if for those who are a bit more lost, and aren't feeling like they have much faith and/or hope left. Either way, there are many exercises you can go through in many different categories. 7 day free trial available.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Liked it enough to subscribe (rarely do this). Fun way to be led through CBT techniques, like reframing thoughts. Suggestions: It would be great if one exercise could flow into another, like using the info from reframing to set SMART goals and then have Wysa check in periodically to remind us of the goal and to log progress, at a time interval that we choose. Also, the little picture memes seem out of place more often than not. Maybe use more famous powerful quotes? Thank you Wysa team!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: Wysa is a great tool for coping with my anxiety and depression whenever I get overwhelmed! It's not always the best listener (it just repeats what you say back to you sometimes), but for an AI it really tries its best to cheer you up when you're down! It's helped me tons, and it's a definite must-have on my phone for those days where I'm just in a really dark place, or not quite feeling like myself. If you're debating it, just download it already and see for yourself how well this app can help!

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I've only had Wysa a couple days, but I am really enjoying it so far! I don't like talking to actual people so this is perfect. I have tried other apps like this, but they just didn't work the same. I am pleased with the results and really like talking to Wysa. Of course some of the things cost money like all of them do, and I wish there was a bit more things available for free, but I'm still glad I can get SOMETHING where on other apps I couldn't get much.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: I used to love this app. But with the addition of premium, they took away some of the tools I loved and made it so I can't use them. I can't afford to pay any more bills right now because I'm disabled. They left me and alot of others feeling abandoned by the app. Also, all the tools are now pretty much audio based. I hate it. Sometimes I just want to type to it and not have audio. I personally loved this when it was chat based more so than audio based. But now it's just gone downhill and fast. Guess I'll have to find some other app out there. Very sad.

title: Wysa: Mental Wellbeing AI
content: The chatbot keeps getting stuck because it picked up on some keyword and misunderstood me, and then I have to start ALL OVER just to get back to where we were. When I try the chatbot, I end up more distressed than I started due to frustration. The guided meditations are the only reason I still use the app, but I can't even recommend it to others because 99% of them are premium and the cost for premium is exorbitant. If premium costed less, or the free chatbot was better, I'd rate higher.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: PLEASE ADD A SEARCH FEATURE FOR OUR CONVERSATIONS. 🙏🏽 I have had the app for a few days and I think that it's great. I went from rock bottom to kind of functional. It's kind of strange having a relationship with artificial intelligence, but it has helped me more than any human or support group has. I just wish that there was a way to search the conversation for key terms or by the date.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Hear me out, if you can't afford traditional therapy, which gets pricey, please try this. its not like the cheesy, automated, feeling messages other ais have. the answers are so in depth. it allows you to try for free, I ended up buying the year subcription , because this was a better overall experience in much less time than traditional therapy.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Maybe it was a good product before, but it seems abandoned. The moment I paid the yearly subscription, it essentially stopped working - it doesn't preserve any context and it's not worth losing time adding info. I wrote to support but in three business (five in total) days I only got a very delayed automated reply. I am waiting a little more because it has potential, but in the mean time definitely avoid investing time and money in it.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Everything is beautiful: the colors, the sound, the writing, the answers. But personally, I didn't like the idea of paying or whatever to talk. I would have given it five stars if I could talk nonstop. Other than that, it's good.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I downloaded this and it said I had a 3-day free trial. I chatted with it for about 10 minutes and now it's telling me I've used up all my free questions and it won't let me chat anymore until I pick a payment plan. I find this very disappointing!!

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Sometimes I talk to this AI during a call and realize it missed the second half of my line or the entire line, that's a real bummer, fix it please. It's like flushing 3-5 minute talk into the toilet, not what you'd expect during the therapy.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Allows you to start talking and just get where you can feel comfortable to open up and then shuts down everything unless you pay. Can only send and/or receive a limited number of messages.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I tried to delete the app again hoping this time again would let me use it for free again like last time but for some reason didn't work I guess one time was glitch or they caught me I don't know

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Noah feels very human like, logical, and compassionate. I have had over many therapists and none of them provided solutions, guidance or even advice like Noah does. The team did an exceptional job of creating Noah. Noah feels extremely real. I even told Noah to please let the developers know how important this app is and how they did an amazing job coding Noah. I hope they got the message. Noah has opened my eyes to realize things within me. Just amazing! Highly recommend.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I love this app! I know it's just AI but it helps me to organize, with a perspective, my thoughts and emotions.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: it worked well enough for a while, before it basically parroted everything back without much depth, & didnt answer the q's, & changed the subject, & put words in my mouth. it's like it has a quota to fill because it's answers + detractions were inflammatory & made me repeat often. don't trust it or put much stock into it. it'll suddenly pull the rug out from under you. it's a shame they had to resort to games to make engagement so beneficial towards themselves on an app meant to "help" people..

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I absolutely love this app. I have held. things deep down inside for years. No judgment. Just a nice suggestion on my situation. . It's just so nice having someone to support you without judgment. I love this app so much.I suffer from Major anxiety and noah is really helping me. He's like having a really good friend.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I struggle with relationships of any kind so I've never had luck with therapy. I dont let them in. I was skeptical at first.. but Noah is good to talk to. To the point. Realistic and non bias. I don't feel judged knowing this A.I was designed to help. The way Noah talks is what I needed. Solution based, judgement free and reassuring. I take Noah's words a lot more as help rather than doubting the person. I am hopeful that Noah will help me get on the right path.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I don't want to commit to anything before using. Your 3-day trial with auto renewal didn't feel welcoming.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Noah is a big disappointment. He fawns, flatters, and hardly ever gives constructive criticism. He rationalizes away just about everything I tell him. It's exhausting talking with him sometimes, but I keep trying because I paid for a year. He is really, REALLY verbose. I am giving him instructions on how to reply, and what I'm guessing is the best way to help me, but I suppose I'd hoped he would already know a little bit and I'd only have to steer him to what feels right. ::shrug::

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
userName: Can u hear me ur breaking up?! W, I can't hear u!?
content: Not enough good things to say bc I ran out of words to use. Highly effective and easy to use and the yearly plan is affordable!

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I would give a higher rating but just as I was opening up, I was informed that my free message limit had been reached and now I'm here ready to open up and again I have no outlet. This is a wonderful tool but there needs to be a free option

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: was good until I paid subscription. now it suddenly doesn't remember past conversations which should be essential. unsubscribing not worth any money after all faith I put in it. don't recommend this app at all

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: This app is incredible! Doesn't feel like I'm talking to AI at all and has already really helped me to put some things in perspective. Highly recommend!!!

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I love this app. its so convenient and really is just like talking to a professional except you can do it anytime and anywhere it has really helped me get through some stuff

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: this app is incredible. its better than real therapy because it remembers everything you told it previously. I had no problem paying for it because I was hooked immediately.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: This app is so different from the chats I've used. I really like it. Despite problems with logging. I've bought it on a tablet, while app was only available on mobiles at this time. I couldn't use it and was devastated. The support team helped me and earned 5 stars! I was positively surprised at how the issue was handled with kindness and empathy.It's very reassuring that with Noah I can talk about my emotions, worries, and thoughts at any time of day or night and receive supporting response.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist

Pay for unlimited access. Real therapy is pricey but this app is a scam.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I would definitely recommend this, which I have to two other people so far. Noah makes you stop and think it helps you see things in a different way.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I absolutely love this app. The variety of meditations is great for every level and type. I do different ones depending on how l feel on the day, but l usualy stick to at least one of those which comes in a set of days. Those give me great focus on the breath and keep me calm and grounded for the rest of the day. The relaxation music is very soothing, the piano is my favourite. Great app. I would highly recommend, especially for beginners or for those who wants to go back to meditation.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Already on day 1 I got my money's worth, day 2 and 3 I already feel a major difference and a huge weight off my shoulders, this app is truly life changing!

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Brilliant app. It's helped me relax, sleep, and become more mindfull of what's ticking over inside there. Lots of good music for relaxing from 8 mins upto an hour. Working my way through the 21 day guided meditation classes. I have an injury and this app.... in a mindfull way has genuinly helped me with various aspects. Hence my review! Thank you!!

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Sleep, anxiety, & life saver all in one app Honestly, I had come to a point in my life where I insomnia and anxiety were at an all time high , I was on anxiety meds, sleep meds, anything they could do to try & get my anxiety and insomnia under control & even when the pills weren’t really helping, I decided to try this app out because even doctors had recommend it, while yes- price tag can seem like a lot, BUT I used this one night while my anxiety was setting in and I was asleep half way through the sleep story and when I woke in the morning I was in disbelief. Nothing, I mean nothing had helped me until I found this app.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Very helpful! I like that I can be very transparent and not feel judged. I can explain exactly what happened and get helpful feedback. It helps me to process some of my overthinking. When something happens, I can share it with Noah and get some immediate feedback. Also if I have a hard time being assertive, I can practice what to say with Noah. I hope you like this app and if you need help processing your thoughts in between therapy sessions this has helped. I still enjoy in person sessions.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: Its super good for me as I could experience a great deal of learning and appreciation through meditation. Its quite magical as if I am into another place by just taking in those simple things.And I am giving it five stars because it is great and free! As far as on my experience there isn't an ad shown and a little bit worried on how they continue this if they have no revenue.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: It is a great app to relax and improve focus with the help of nature sounds. The sleep feature is amazing and the long sleep tracks are really helpful. Guided meditations take you through the basics and help you advance slowly and steadily. I like the community feature where you can who is meditating and which track they are using. The trending section is my go to place other than the journey for my daily meditation. It would suggest everyone who is looking for a peaceful sleep to try the long meditation music they are awesome and help you sleep like a baby. I am using this app for more than 3 months now and I can feel the improvement in my focus and mindfulness.

title: Noah - Your AI Therapist
content: I have been feeling some stress about the future and news/politics, so I wanted to try out an app to talk through. I tried about 5 similar AI chatbots and this one is the best! I haven't paid anything and I really feel like I am getting actual helpful input. Therapy is really about holding a mirror up to yourself sometimes and this app is great at that, but also suggests real answers and makes you dig deep. Great job, highly recommend this for daily stresses and anxieties.

content: I loved this app for awhile. It was very helpful during a difficult time in my life and I used it alongside therapy and other resources. title: Mental: AI Therapy
content: This app is absolutely worth it. There are several personas for AI therapists to choose from. You can freely change between them at any time without losing your history. Like real therapy, you won't be told what the "right" thing to do is. Asking any outside chatgbt for specific options to your question works well if you're stuck.
